The WebSurfer results clearly identify the opposing group to the Irish Catholics in the Shiners' War as "French Canadians." The conflict was between Irish and French Canadians; therefore, the ethnic group that participated in the conflict is French Canadians, regardless of the precise timeline of their full ethnogenesis, as they were the established population in the Ottawa Valley prior to the influx of Irish immigrants. The answer should be "French Canadians" (or Acadians/French), not "English."
